location: Dustwallow Marsh, on Alcaz Island off the coast
entrance: In the basement of the large building on Alcaz Island, off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, around /way 75 15. From the dock, take the path up the hill to the left.

96772.objective: Recover Zarla's Journal from the depths of Alcaz Prison.
96772.note: From Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran. Zarla Ober drops the journal. Reputation with the Kirin Tor and Stormwind.

95262.objective: Enter Alcaz Prison and learn what became of the King of Stormwind.
95262.note: Last step of the SI:7 chain that starts with Our Man in Theramore from Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. The rewards come with Shaw Needs To Know, back in Stormwind.

96381.objective: Kill 15 Strashaz Soldiers and 8 Strashaz Enchantresses and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass.
96381.note: From Sully McCleary in Dustwallow Marsh, after Our Man in Theramore.

95309.objective: Enter Alcaz Prison and find Commander Folkar.
95309.note: Last step of the chain that starts with The Missing Kor'kron from Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. Inside it goes on with The Honor of the Kor'kron and Bad News for Folkar, and the rewards come with Thrall Needs to Know in Orgrimmar.

96332.objective: Kill 15 Strashaz Soldiers and 8 Strashaz Enchantresses and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass.
96332.note: From Sergeant Ulka on Alcaz Island, after The Missing Kor'kron. The Horde version of A Bit of Wet Work.

96334.objective: Collect 8 Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards inside.
96334.note: From Sergeant Ulka on Alcaz Island; hand it in to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar.

96335.objective: Recover the Ornate Shackle Key from The Questioner.
96335.note: Only appears after the last boss if The Questioner is still alive. The start of the Defias disguise toy, see the guide.
